one_line_description: Devin is an AI software engineer that can handle most tasks, excluding extremely difficult tasks. It can be integrated with an MCP server or used as agent skills.
auth_notes: Devin uses a principal + token model. A Service User API Key authenticates as the service user, and a Personal Access Token authenticates as the human user.
gate_detail: Devin offers a free trial, but for full access, users need to sign up and may need to choose a paid plan.
